The fixed circuit ran on garnet:mock with 100 shots. Job 01a15f9f-7336-7724-a806-5749685a7675 completed with counts {"00": 46, "11": 54}. Only correlated outcomes appeared, so the circuit makes a Bell pair.

The original circuit had two bugs:
1. QB25 does not exist. Garnet has qubits QB1 to QB20. On garnet:mock, QB1 couples only to QB2 and QB4. I replaced QB25 with QB2.
2. cx is not a native IQM gate. The native gates are prx, cz and measure. I rewrote the CNOT from QB1 to QB2 as three gates: prx(angle=pi/2, phase=pi/2) on QB2, then cz with locus [QB2, QB1], then prx(angle=-pi/2, phase=pi/2) on QB2. That locus order is the one the architecture lists for this pair.

The first prx on QB1 is unchanged. It is Ry(pi/2), which puts QB1 into superposition. The measure instruction now measures QB1 and QB2 under key "m".

The fixed circuit is in /Users/claytonchancey/Desktop/quantum/.claude/worktrees/wf_3612af23-e49-14/run_bell_fixed.py.
